/categories/church/sermon-toolbox.description: Explore Bible study and sermon-planning resources for developing biblically grounded messages that encourage Kingdom maturity.

/categories/church/bibleproject-ot.description: Browse BibleProject video overviews of Old Testament books, from Genesis through the prophets, to follow the story and themes of Scripture.

/categories/church/bibleproject-nt.description: Browse BibleProject video overviews of New Testament books, including the Gospels, Acts, letters, and Revelation.

/categories/church/biblical-counseling-i.description: Explore biblical counseling topics for individuals and families, including spiritual healing, inner peace, and living in God's ways.

/categories/church/rapid-church-planting.description: Study Joshua Nations church planting lessons on vision, planning, teams, outreach, regular gatherings, and discipling new believers.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god.title: Attributes of God: His Character in Scripture | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god.description: Study God's character through lessons on his self-existence, sovereignty, holiness, love, and other attributes revealed in Scripture.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/a-b.title: A Balanced Vision of God's Character | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/a-b.description: Consider both God's kindness and severity in Scripture and why knowing him means receiving his character as he reveals it.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Self-Existent: The Great I AM | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Explore God's self-existence through his name, I AM, and biblical passages that describe his life as depending on nothing outside himself.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Eternal: Without Beginning or End | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Read Scripture on God's eternal nature, from his existence before creation to the Alpha and Omega who remains through every age.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Transcendent: Beyond Creation | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Explore biblical passages about the God whom heaven cannot contain, distinct from and greater than the creation he sustains.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Spirit: Worship in Spirit and Truth | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Study what Scripture says about God's invisible, immaterial nature and Jesus' call to worship the Father in spirit and truth.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Unchanging: His Constant Character | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Reflect on God's unchanging character and purposes through Malachi, the Psalms, and other biblical passages.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Sovereign: His Rule Over Creation | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Study God's sovereignty in creation and history through Scripture's account of his rule over all he has made.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is All-Powerful: Understanding Omnipotence | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Explore God's power in the biblical accounts of creation and his promises, and consider what it means that nothing is too difficult for him.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is All-Knowing: Understanding Omniscience | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Explore Scripture on God's complete knowledge, including Psalm 139 and Jesus' knowledge of Nathanael.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Present Everywhere: Omnipresence | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Read Psalm 139 and other passages on God's presence in every place, from the heights of heaven to the depths of the sea.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Free: Acting According to His Will | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Consider biblical teaching on God's freedom to act according to his own will, unconstrained by anything outside himself.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Holy: His Purity and Otherness | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Explore God's holiness through Isaiah's vision and Moses at the burning bush, where his purity calls for reverence.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Righteous: Perfect in His Ways | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Study Scripture's portrait of God's righteousness: his morally perfect character and the rightness of all his ways.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Just: Justice in His Judgments | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Explore biblical accounts of God's justice, including the flood and the Passover, alongside his mercy toward those he preserves.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Faithful: Keeper of His Promises | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Read how God's faithfulness appears in his covenant with Israel and his promise to Abraham, and reflect on his trustworthy character.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Absolute Truth: His Trustworthy Word | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Study biblical passages about God's truthfulness, the impossibility of his lying, and the reliability of his word.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Love: His Self-Giving Character | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Reflect on God's love in 1 John and the gift of his Son, and consider how Scripture describes his self-giving character.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Merciful: Compassion and Forgiveness | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Explore God's mercy in Scripture, from his self-description in Exodus to his compassion and forgiveness toward sinners.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Gracious: His Unearned Favor | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Study God's grace through biblical accounts of his freely given favor to people who could not earn it.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Good: His Character and Works | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Reflect on God's goodness in Scripture, including his revelation to Moses and the psalmist's declaration that he is good and does good.

/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.title: God Is Wise: Wisdom in His Works | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/attributes-of-god/god.description: Explore God's wisdom in creation and his works through passages from Proverbs, the Psalms, and Daniel.

/categories/growth/identity-in-christ.title: Your Identity in Christ: Christian Growth | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/identity-in-christ.description: Explore what the Bible says about your new identity in Christ and lessons on living as God's child, part of Christ's body, and a citizen of his Kingdom.

/categories/growth/ministry-holy-spirit.title: Walking in the Spirit: Christian Living | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/ministry-holy-spirit.description: Study the Holy Spirit's work in believers through lessons on surrender, being filled with the Spirit, daily dependence, and spiritual fruit.

/categories/growth/hope-times-crisis.title: Hope in Times of Crisis: Biblical Encouragement | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/hope-times-crisis.description: Find lessons on God's presence, promises, guidance, prayer, and peace for reflecting on biblical hope during difficult times.

/categories/growth/bible-promises-hope.title: Bible Promises for Hope in Every Season | JO EQUIP
/categories/growth/bible-promises-hope.description: Explore Bible promises about God's authority and encouragement for your circumstances, feelings, relationships, identity, and future.
